title: Library
content: I was inside the library last night. I was supposed to check out a book to take it home with me. I forgot my library card and I let the teacher know about my situation. She told me that I was to write an essay about the book I chose and that it's due on this Wednesday. I walked outside the library and I just woke up immediately from my dream. The thing that caught my attention from my dream is that apparently I have my essay due this Wednesday. I wonder what that means.
